notes: Corrected the placement of the phrase's single the: עַבְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ חִזְקִיָּהוּ writes an article on the rectum and the ASV renders the rectum anarthrously, so rule 29's fronting case governs and the article takes the written the while the construct stays bare.
This does not conflict with 2KI.19.1, where the same הַמֶּלֶךְ חִזְקִיָּהוּ stands with no the written for it at all and the article is unrepresented under rule 29's last sentence.

The competing reading, which the accepted alignment took, supplies a the on עַבְדֵי and leaves the article unrepresented; rule 29 permits a supplied the on a construct only where no article morpheme is present.
